numbers: inset frame/long rules on 89.7% of typography posters (35/39), 20.8% of shotcraft, 31.5% of 251; has_border is a full-width strong-gradient rule test, so the 31.5% overall figure may over-count while the typography figure matches the visible frame
do: Draw one inset rectangle or a set of long rules on the measured margin and keep them clear of the type band
antipattern: Bare floating type on a plate with no frame, rule or edge anywhere

rule: Give a rounded panel a radius near 10 px at 1920, and never more than 84 px unless it is a deliberate pill
why: The pack's panel rule fixes frost alpha and rim width but names no radius, so panels drift into pills with no measured reference
numbers: measured radii median 10 px at 1920, max 84 px; rounded panel on 22.7% of 251 posters, 10.3% of typography, 25.0% of shotcraft; a stadium pill in chipcycle measures about 17 px; has_radius fires only on the largest smooth blob so 22.7% is a floor rather than the true rate
do: Set the radius to 10 px for a card and reserve 40-84 px for a pill or a stadium chip
antipattern: A 40 px radius on every small card so the panel reads as a pill

rule: Place the biggest type band on the vertical centre of a type-led frame, at 47.2% of frame height
why: The measured typography tree does not put type in the upper third; only image-led frames push type up, so a copied upper-third layout leaves the lower half dead
numbers: typography type band y0 median 0.472 of frame height (dead centre); shotcraft median 0.331 (upper third); type band ink coverage inside its own box median 15.0%; measured on 251 posters
do: Set the big band's top edge to 47% of frame height for a type-led frame and measure y0 on the still
antipattern: An upper-third composition copied from an image-led reference while the type sits at 33% and the lower half is empty

rule: If a frame is a full-page text plate, let the text band run past half the frame height and keep the column dense
why: The library contains a designed full-page document and no rule covers it, so the natural-size rules would flag a real house treatment as a defect
numbers: library/media/typography/docwrite/poster.webp type band reaches 72.9% of frame height; density tail: codeblock 14 lines at 6 px per line, dotsword 7 lines, cutout 28 lines at about 7 px; 11 of 251 posters have no measurable text band; typography est_font_px median 94, p90 121
do: Declare the document plate in the scene table and let the band reach 70-75% of frame height with the column on the measured grid
antipattern: Calling a 72.9% document band an oversized headline and cutting it back to the 94 px house size

rule: Give opener and outro distinct memorable hooks with an earned payoff
why: A memorable opening promise and a satisfying closing answer make the short feel intentional rather than generic
numbers: Qualitative review; no numeric threshold
do: Name the opener hook, the outro payoff, and the link between them; verify the payoff with owner feedback
antipattern: Generic opening or closing line; payoff asserted without owner feedback

rule: Inspect the local typography catalog and actual implementation; choose a treatment justified by story, letterform shape, and function
why: Catalog metadata proves availability only; implementation inspection and rendered review are needed to establish reuse and Persian shaping
numbers: For each candidate record its exact catalog key, source path/ref, and story job; verify implementation and rendered Persian shaping before calling it reusable or validated
do: Search library/data/typography-models.json; record exact key + source path/ref + story job; inspect implementation; review rendered Persian shaping
antipattern: Treating a catalog key as a ready-made component or metadata as proof of correct shaping

rule: Separate observed evidence, owner feedback, and inference; omit invented facts and numeric thresholds
why: Clear evidence classes prevent assumptions from being presented as findings
numbers: Qualitative review; no numeric threshold
do: Label observations, owner feedback, and inference distinctly; state only supported claims
antipattern: Invented details, unsupported numbers, or inference presented as observation

rule: Check text flicker on consecutive rendered frames or playback
why: Static lint can detect source patterns but cannot prove temporal stability in rendered text
numbers: Qualitative review; no numeric threshold
do: Inspect adjacent rendered frames or playback at text changes and holds
antipattern: Treating a passing static lint as proof of temporal stability
